general_skills.title: Goal-Driven Room Sweep
general_skills.when_to_apply: At episode start and whenever the current search area is exhausted without finding the goal object.

meta.D-PLAN: Decompose the task into an ordered checklist: (1) identify all candidate locations for the goal object based on object category priors, (2) visit each location exactly once in a logical spatial order (e.g., left-to-right, near-to-far), (3) extend to secondary locations only after exhausting primary candidates. Never revisit a confirmed-empty location unless the environment signals a state change.
meta.D-TRACK: Maintain two sets: SEARCHED (locations fully inspected this episode) and PENDING (locations not yet visited). After each inspection, move the location from PENDING to SEARCHED. If the goal object is found, record its location immediately.
meta.D-GUARD: Never restart the sweep from the beginning when a location is empty — always advance to the next PENDING candidate. Do not attempt to place or transform any object before it is in hand. Maintain a SEARCHED set updated after every inspection and always select the next target from the PENDING set — never return to a SEARCHED location unless the environment signals a state change there.

meta.D-TRACK: Update the held-object inventory immediately after a successful take action. If multiple goal objects are needed, decrement the outstanding count.
meta.D-GUARD: Never walk away from a visible goal object to continue exploration — this leads to losing track of it and wasting steps on a redundant search. Immediately interrupt any ongoing exploration upon sighting a goal object and issue the take action as the very next step — do not defer pickup to finish a sweep.

general_skills.when_to_apply: Throughout any multi-instance task (e.g., 'put two X in Y').
